model.webtracking_default_dbt.mart_web_v.description: Visitor 360 profile mart with lifetime session, conversion, and loyalty indicators.
model.webtracking_default_dbt.mart_web_v.raw_code:
-- Visitor profile mart. Rollups come from staging (not mart_web_sessions)
-- so ClickHouse CREATE VIEW does not nest complex joins / window views.
with sess_rollup as (
    select
        visitor_id,
        website_id,
        count(*) as session_count,
        min(started_at) as first_session_at,
        max(started_at) as last_session_at
    from {{ ref('stg_web_sessions') }}
    group by visitor_id, website_id
),

pv_rollup as (
    select
        visitor_id,
        website_id,
        count(*) as lifetime_pageviews
    from {{ ref('stg_page_views') }}
    group by visitor_id, website_id
),

conv_rollup as (
    select
        visitor_id,
        website_id,
        count(*) as lifetime_conversions,
        sum(value) as lifetime_revenue
    from {{ ref('stg_conversion_events') }}
    group by visitor_id, website_id
)

select
    -- Explicit aliases: ClickHouse otherwise keeps names like `v.visitor_id`.
    v.visitor_id as visitor_id,
    v.website_id as website_id,
    v.organization_id as organization_id,
    v.user_id as user_id,
    v.anonymous_id as anonymous_id,
    coalesce(s.session_count, v.total_sessions, 1) as lifetime_sessions,
    coalesce(p.lifetime_pageviews, v.total_pageviews, 1) as lifetime_pageviews,
    if(coalesce(s.session_count, v.total_sessions, 1) > 1, 1, 0) as is_returning_visitor,
    coalesce(c.lifetime_conversions, 0) as lifetime_conversions,
    coalesce(c.lifetime_revenue, 0.0) as lifetime_revenue,
    v.country as country,
    v.is_identified_flag as is_identified_flag,
    coalesce(s.first_session_at, v.first_seen_at) as first_seen_at,
    coalesce(s.last_session_at, v.last_seen_at) as last_seen_at,
    v.created_at as created_at
from {{ ref('stg_web_visitors') }} v
left join sess_rollup s
    on v.visitor_id = s.visitor_id and v.website_id = s.website_id
left join pv_rollup p
    on v.visitor_id = p.visitor_id and v.website_id = p.website_id
left join conv_rollup c
    on v.visitor_id = c.visitor_id and v.website_id = c.website_id

model.webtracking_default_dbt.mart_web_s.name: mart_web_sessions
model.webtracking_default_dbt.mart_web_s.description: Session grain analytical mart. Bounce, duration, and pageview_count come from v_session_bounce (dashboard truth). exit_page is derived from fact_page_views (argMax). is_online_flag marks activity in the last 5 minutes. Enrichment flags (rage/dead/form/conversion) come from fact rollups. Period new/returning visitor counts (≤1 / >1 sessions in window) are computed at query time — not from is_first_session_flag (lifetime first-ever only).
model.webtracking_default_dbt.mart_web_s.raw_code:
-- Session grain mart aligned to ClickHouse dashboard truth:
--   bounce / duration / pageview_count  → v_session_bounce
--   exit_page                           → argMax(page_path) from fact_page_views
--   engagement enrichment flags         → fact_* session rollups
-- Do NOT invent GA4 bounce or use dim_sessions.is_bounce / stale duration.

with pv_agg as (
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        count(*) as page_view_count,
        max(max_scroll_depth) as max_session_scroll_depth,
        argMax(page_path, created_at) as exit_page_derived,
        min(created_at) as first_pv_at,
        max(created_at) as last_pv_at
    from {{ ref('stg_page_views') }}
    group by website_id, session_id
),

int_agg as (
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        countIf(event_type = 'click') as total_clicks,
        countIf(event_type = 'rage_click') as rage_click_count,
        countIf(event_type = 'dead_click') as dead_click_count,
        maxIf(
            if(scroll_depth > 0 and scroll_depth <= 1.0000001, scroll_depth * 100.0, scroll_depth),
            event_type = 'scroll_depth'
        ) as max_scroll_depth_ie,
        min(created_at) as first_int_at,
        max(created_at) as last_int_at
    from {{ ref('stg_interaction_events') }}
    group by website_id, session_id
),

conv_agg as (
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        count(*) as conversion_count,
        sum(value) as total_revenue,
        countIf(conversion_type = 'purchase') as purchase_count,
        countIf(conversion_type = 'signup') as signup_count
    from {{ ref('stg_conversion_events') }}
    group by website_id, session_id
),

form_agg as (
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        countIf(event_type = 'form_view') as form_view_count,
        countIf(event_type = 'form_start') as form_start_count,
        countIf(event_type = 'form_submit') as form_submit_count,
        countIf(event_type = 'form_success') as form_success_count,
        countIf(event_type = 'form_failure') as form_failure_count,
        countIf(event_type = 'form_abandon') as form_abandon_count
    from {{ ref('stg_form_events') }}
    group by website_id, session_id
),

custom_agg as (
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        countIf(event_name = 'site_search') as search_count
    from {{ ref('stg_custom_events') }}
    group by website_id, session_id
),

err_agg as (
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        count(*) as error_count
    from {{ ref('stg_error_events') }}
    group by website_id, session_id
),

prod_agg as (
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        count(*) as product_interaction_count,
        countIf(section = 'product_view') as product_view_count,
        countIf(section = 'add_to_cart') as cart_add_count,
        countIf(section = 'begin_checkout') as checkout_start_count
    from {{ ref('stg_product_interactions') }}
    group by website_id, session_id
),

session_order as (
    -- Lifetime first-ever session flag (profile enrichment).
    -- Period new/returning (≤1 / >1 sessions in window) is computed at query time
    -- in SQL templates — not from this flag.
    select
        website_id,
        session_id,
        row_number() over (
            partition by website_id, visitor_id
            order by started_at asc, session_id asc
        ) as visitor_session_rank
    from {{ ref('stg_web_sessions') }}
)

select
    s.session_id as session_id,
    s.visitor_id as visitor_id,
    s.website_id as website_id,
    s.organization_id as organization_id,
    s.user_id as user_id,
    -- Prefer v_session_bounce.session_started_at so period pills match dashboard bounce grain.
    coalesce(b.session_started_at, s.started_at) as started_at,
    s.ended_at as ended_at,
    s.updated_at as updated_at,

    -- Tier-1 duration / pageviews / bounce from v_session_bounce
    coalesce(b.duration_seconds, toUInt32(0)) as duration_seconds,
    coalesce(b.pageview_count, p.page_view_count, toUInt64(0)) as page_view_count,
    coalesce(b.is_bounce_flag, toUInt8(0)) as is_bounce_flag,
    -- Engaged = inverse of dashboard bounce (not GA4 engaged-session)
    if(coalesce(b.is_bounce_flag, toUInt8(0)) = 1, 0, 1) as is_engaged_flag,

    -- Online: active in last 5 minutes (dashboard real-time card)
    if(
        greatest(s.updated_at, coalesce(s.ended_at, s.updated_at))
            >= now64(3) - toIntervalMinute(5),
        1,
        0
    ) as is_online_flag,

    if(so.visitor_session_rank = 1, 1, 0) as is_first_session_flag,

    coalesce(i.total_clicks, 0) as total_clicks,
    coalesce(i.rage_click_count, 0) as rage_click_count,
    if(coalesce(i.rage_click_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_rage_clicks,
    coalesce(i.dead_click_count, 0) as dead_click_count,
    if(coalesce(i.dead_click_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_dead_clicks,
    greatest(
        coalesce(p.max_session_scroll_depth, 0.0),
        coalesce(i.max_scroll_depth_ie, 0.0)
    ) as max_session_scroll_depth,
    if(
        greatest(
            coalesce(p.max_session_scroll_depth, 0.0),
            coalesce(i.max_scroll_depth_ie, 0.0)
        ) >= 50.0,
        1,
        0
    ) as has_deep_scroll,
    coalesce(c.conversion_count, 0) as conversion_count,
    if(coalesce(c.conversion_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_conversion,
    coalesce(c.total_revenue, 0.0) as total_revenue,
    coalesce(c.purchase_count, 0) as purchase_count,
    if(coalesce(c.purchase_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_purchase,
    coalesce(c.signup_count, 0) as signup_count,
    if(coalesce(c.signup_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_signup,
    coalesce(pr.checkout_start_count, 0) as checkout_start_count,
    if(coalesce(pr.checkout_start_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_checkout_start,
    coalesce(pr.cart_add_count, 0) as cart_add_count,
    if(coalesce(pr.cart_add_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_cart_add,
    coalesce(pr.product_interaction_count, 0) as product_interaction_count,
    if(coalesce(pr.product_view_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_product_view,
    coalesce(f.form_view_count, 0) as form_view_count,
    coalesce(f.form_start_count, 0) as form_start_count,
    if(coalesce(f.form_start_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_form_start,
    coalesce(f.form_submit_count, 0) as form_submit_count,
    if(coalesce(f.form_submit_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_form_submit,
    coalesce(f.form_success_count, 0) as form_success_count,
    if(coalesce(f.form_success_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_form_success,
    coalesce(f.form_failure_count, 0) as form_failure_count,
    if(coalesce(f.form_failure_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_form_failure,
    coalesce(f.form_abandon_count, 0) as form_abandon_count,
    if(coalesce(f.form_abandon_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_form_abandon,
    coalesce(cu.search_count, 0) as search_count,
    if(coalesce(cu.search_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_search,
    coalesce(e.error_count, 0) as error_count,
    if(coalesce(e.error_count, 0) > 0, 1, 0) as has_error,

    s.entry_page as entry_page,
    -- dim_sessions.exit_page is empty; derive from last page view
    coalesce(nullIf(p.exit_page_derived, ''), nullIf(s.exit_page, ''), '') as exit_page,
    s.referrer as referrer,
    s.referrer_domain as referrer_domain,
    s.utm_source as utm_source,
    s.utm_medium as utm_medium,
    s.utm_campaign as utm_campaign,
    s.utm_term as utm_term,
    s.utm_content as utm_content,
    s.wt_organization_id as wt_organization_id,
    s.wt_campaign_id as wt_campaign_id,
    s.wt_contact_id as wt_contact_id,
    s.device as device,
    s.browser as browser,
    s.browser_version as browser_version,
    s.platform as platform,
    s.country as country,
    s.city as city,
    s.region as region,
    s.latitude as latitude,
    s.longitude as longitude,
    s.is_campaign_attributed as is_campaign_attributed,
    s.is_identified as is_identified,
    s.created_at as created_at
from {{ ref('stg_web_sessions') }} s
left join {{ ref('stg_session_bounce') }} b
    on s.website_id = b.website_id and s.session_id = b.session_id
left join pv_agg p
    on s.website_id = p.website_id and s.session_id = p.session_id
left join int_agg i
    on s.website_id = i.website_id and s.session_id = i.session_id
left join conv_agg c
    on s.website_id = c.website_id and s.session_id = c.session_id
left join form_agg f
    on s.website_id = f.website_id and s.session_id = f.session_id
left join custom_agg cu
    on s.website_id = cu.website_id and s.session_id = cu.session_id
left join err_agg e
    on s.website_id = e.website_id and s.session_id = e.session_id
left join prod_agg pr
    on s.website_id = pr.website_id and s.session_id = pr.session_id
left join session_order so
    on s.website_id = so.website_id and s.session_id = so.session_id

model.webtracking_default_dbt.stg_page_v.raw_code:
-- Page views enriched for engagement KPIs:
--   max_scroll_depth  ← fact_page_views, else max scroll_depth interaction (0–100%)
--   time_on_page_sec  ← fact_page_views when >0, else gap to next pageview in session
--                     (capped 1–300s to match dashboard-style dwell; last PV → 0)

with base as (
    select
        page_view_id,
        session_id,
        visitor_id,
        website_id,
        coalesce(organization_id, 0) as organization_id,
        page_path,
        page_title,
        referrer,
        time_on_page_sec as raw_time_on_page_sec,
        max_scroll_depth as raw_max_scroll_depth,
        device,
        country,
        utm_source,
        utm_medium,
        utm_campaign,
        sdk_version,
        created_at
    from {{ source('web_tracking', 'fact_page_views') }}
),

scroll_by_pv as (
    select
        page_view_id,
        max(scroll_depth) as scroll_depth
    from {{ source('web_tracking', 'fact_interaction_events') }}
    where event_type = 'scroll_depth'
      and page_view_id != ''
    group by page_view_id
),

scroll_by_session_path as (
    select
        session_id,
        page_path,
        max(scroll_depth) as scroll_depth
    from {{ source('web_tracking', 'fact_interaction_events') }}
    where event_type = 'scroll_depth'
    group by session_id, page_path
),

with_next as (
    select
        b.page_view_id as page_view_id,
        b.session_id as session_id,
        b.visitor_id as visitor_id,
        b.website_id as website_id,
        b.organization_id as organization_id,
        b.page_path as page_path,
        b.page_title as page_title,
        b.referrer as referrer,
        b.raw_time_on_page_sec as raw_time_on_page_sec,
        b.device as device,
        b.country as country,
        b.utm_source as utm_source,
        b.utm_medium as utm_medium,
        b.utm_campaign as utm_campaign,
        b.sdk_version as sdk_version,
        b.created_at as created_at,
        leadInFrame(b.created_at) over (
            partition by b.website_id, b.session_id
            order by b.created_at
            rows between unbounded preceding and unbounded following
        ) as next_created_at,
        coalesce(
            nullIf(sp.scroll_depth, 0),
            nullIf(ss.scroll_depth, 0),
            b.raw_max_scroll_depth
        ) as scroll_merged
    from base as b
    left join scroll_by_pv as sp
        on b.page_view_id = sp.page_view_id
    left join scroll_by_session_path as ss
        on b.session_id = ss.session_id
       and b.page_path = ss.page_path
)

select
    page_view_id,
    session_id,
    visitor_id,
    website_id,
    organization_id,
    page_path,
    page_title,
    referrer,
    if(
        raw_time_on_page_sec > 0,
        raw_time_on_page_sec,
        if(
            next_created_at > created_at
            and dateDiff('second', created_at, next_created_at) between 1 and 300,
            toUInt32(dateDiff('second', created_at, next_created_at)),
            toUInt32(0)
        )
    ) as time_on_page_sec,
    if(
        scroll_merged > 0 and scroll_merged <= 1.0000001,
        scroll_merged * 100.0,
        coalesce(scroll_merged, 0.0)
    ) as max_scroll_depth,
    device,
    country,
    utm_source,
    utm_medium,
    utm_campaign,
    sdk_version,
    created_at
from with_next

doc.dbt.__overview__.block_contents:
### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
